JOYSTAR Marcher 12" Kids Balance Bike
Give your child the gift of confidence with the JOYSTAR Marcher Balance Bike. Designed for toddlers aged 1.5 to 5 years, this no-pedal push bike removes the stress of training wheels, allowing your little rider to focus on mastering balance and coordination through intuitive play.

Performance & Safety Engineering
"Mastering balance is the first step to a lifetime of cycling. The Marcher is engineered to make that transition smooth and safe."
Built for Young Explorers
The JOYSTAR Marcher features a rugged hi-ten steel frame and a rigid steel fork, providing a stable foundation for active toddlers. To ensure a smooth experience, it is equipped with a ball-bearing headset for precise steering and added stability.

Puncture-proof EVA foam tires ensure a maintenance-free, smooth ride.

Key Features & Benefits

Puncture-Proof Tires: 12-inch EVA polymer airless tires provide a comfortable ride on various terrains without the need for air.

Grow-with-Me Fit: The quick-release seat clamp allows for rapid height adjustments as your child grows.

Confidence Builder: Removing pedals lets children use their feet for propulsion and braking, instilling self-confidence in their riding ability.

Safe for Small Hands: Features comfortable handlebar grips designed specifically for toddler-sized proportions.

Quick & Easy Assembly
Get riding right away! Like all JOYSTAR bikes, the Marcher arrives mostly pre-assembled. With just a few simple steps to attach the handlebars and seat, your child will be ready to glide in minutes.

Assembly Guide: Quick setup for the JOYSTAR Marcher.

Size Chart & Fit Guide

See It In Action

Watch: Experience the freedom of gliding on the JOYSTAR Marcher.

Our Guarantee
We stand by our quality to give you total peace of mind:

Lifetime Frame Warranty: Your steel frame is covered for as long as you own the bike.

Authentic Quality: Every JOYSTAR bike is built to high safety and durability standards.
